study: MW controls for Nesso binding-related score to cellular induction pEC50
classification: retrospective exploratory; reused development folds; no prospective claims
equations: intercept plus FIT-standardized MW; native score; both; both plus their product, respectively
fit: unregularized weighted least squares via numpy.linalg.lstsq, weights 1/max(assay_SE,0.1); fixed objective no tuning. WLS minimizes weighted squared error, not the primary weighted MAE or neural Huber loss.
roles: exact preserved 5 folds x budgets100/500 draw0; FIT80/400 CAL20/100; CAL used for residual intervals only; no test-dependent transformations
inputs: controls_v1/fresh_features native_points.npy + ordered identities; existing identity-SMILES MW; original pEC50 and SE
evaluation: pooled and per-fold full/<215/>215 MAE weightedMAE Spearman bias; paired native/head/LoRA references. Primary performance below215 vs above215 diagnostic thresholds fixed from prior user request.
intervals: same split-conformal unweighted CAL absolute residual rank ceil((ncal+1)*coverage), 80/90%; test point predictions unchanged
verification: cache hashes; role disjointness; exact expected40 fits; rank full; independent normal-equation predictions and serialized-state replay; pooled reference metrics reconciliation
